jobs.name: context7
jobs.prompt:
Create a clean app-style icon set for a developer skill named "Context7".
Concept: Retrieve current third-party library documentation through Context7
Style profile: docs
Palette direction: Indigo + slate + cool gray accents
Motif direction: Pages, layers, maps, knowledge cards
Style: minimal, modern, high contrast, simple geometric forms, no letters or words.
Background: transparent.
Composition: centered symbol with a strong silhouette at small sizes.
Return two coordinated variants: one optimized for tiny UI use and one with richer detail for larger preview.
Output: square images.

Variant instruction: generate the SMALL icon version with strong silhouette clarity and minimal micro-detail for tiny UI rendering.
